resources.string: On the computer, choose “Phone companion · Same Wi-Fi” as the tracking engine and click “Start tracking”, then scan the code it shows. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
The camera is used to scan the pairing code and to track your face on this phone. The video never leaves the phone.
Camera access is off. Allow it in system settings to scan the code and track your face.
Only a direct connection on your local network is used — no account, no internet service.
Point the camera at the pairing code
That is not a VTubeLeaf pairing code.
This code needs another app version (code version %1$d, this app supports %2$d). Update the phone app and the desktop app.
The computer already has a phone connected. Click “Disconnect phone” on the computer, then scan the new code.
This code has expired. Click “Disconnect phone” or restart tracking on the computer and scan the new code.
The computer ended this session. Scan the new code to pair again.
The desktop app uses another protocol version. Update both apps.
The computer rejected the data this app sent. Update both apps.
The computer disconnected this phone. Scan the new code to pair again.
Could not reach the computer. Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi, that the network does not isolate devices (guest mode), and that the computer’s firewall allows VTubeLeaf.
The computer’s identity did not match the code. Scan the code shown on the computer again.
The connection could not be restored within 30 seconds. Tracking was paused.
No face — move into the frame
Preview hidden · the camera is still tracking
Paused while the app was in the background. Press Resume to continue.
The phone is getting hot and may slow down. A short break or better airflow helps.
Tracking paused to protect the phone from overheating. Let it cool down, then press Resume.
Face tracking is not available on this device.
The camera is in use by another app or unavailable. Close that app and press Resume.

The camera image stays on this phone. Only head rotation, eye, mouth and expression values are sent to your computer over your local network, and only after you scan its pairing code. Nothing is stored or uploaded.

Head turn, nod and tilt; left and right eye openness; mouth open and smile; gaze, brows, mouth shift and cheek puff from MediaPipe Face Landmarker. Hands and the upper body are not tracked on the phone. Smoothing, sensitivity and neutral-pose calibration stay on the computer.

1. On the computer, choose “Phone companion · Same Wi-Fi” under “Tracking engine” and click “Start tracking”.
2. Scan the code shown on the computer.
3. Place the phone where it sees your face and press Start.
4. Calibrate your neutral pose on the computer.
Locking the phone, switching apps or a call pauses tracking; press Resume afterwards.
